name: StudyO
tagline: Turns open tabs, PDFs, lectures and videos into flashcards, quizzes, concept maps and summaries.
problem: Students collect sources in dozens of tabs but rarely turn them into learning.
solution: Ingests PDFs, YouTube, web pages, audio and open tabs through an extension, then generates study material, with media handled by Cloudinary.
demo_moment: Team-described: ingest a set of tabs and generate a quiz from them.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Starts from the tabs students already have open.

lessons: Start from the mess users already have, not a blank workspace.
